newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it kills 25 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it kills 25 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Turkish officials said on Thursday that government forces had killed 25 Kurdish guerrillas in two days of clashes in which one member of the security forces died.

The Kurdistan Workers Party (KDP) rebels died in the provinces of Diyarbakir, Bingol, Sirnak and Hakkari in fighting on Wednesday and Thursday, the regional governor's office in the southeastern city of Diyarbakir said in a statement.
It did not say where the member of the security forces was killed.
The PKK, fighting for Kurdish self rule in southeast Turkey, has launched two suicide bomb attacks in the last week, killing three rebels and eight other people.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict.
